_readme: Copy to check-http.json and adapt it to the target API. It holds no secret: tokens come from a variable (token_env) or from a command (token_cmd) that forges them with the application's secret, like generate_link in GoTrue.
token_cmd below uses modules/supabase/templates/auth-nextjs/scripts/forge-token.mjs, copied into the application as scripts/forge-token.mjs. Relative paths resolve from the folder of THIS file.
Placeholders in paths, bodies and headers: {token} (current identity), {token:name}, {id:name}.
matrix[].count: 'header:X-Total-Count' (server-side count, preferred), 'json' (length of the list), 'json:<key>'.
matrix[].owner: column that holds the owner's id; adds the row <resource>#others (other users' rows that are visible, expected 0).
Expected: 0, '>0', '*', a number (frozen corpus); status: one code or a list of codes.
Write checks run ONLY on the target. --read-only replays the matrix only.
